doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: Clark Terry, Cadillac Williams and Richard Williams
summary: Clark Terry named Joe Wilder, Snooky and Cadillac Williams; DiMartino recalls playing a solo after Terry on video.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Clark Terry used to tell me. I’d say, “Who did you like?” He says Joe Wilder and of course Snooky. And then he mentioned Cadillac Williams. And I said, “Who’s Cadillac Williams?” I said, “Cadillac Williams?” I go — he said, “You should check out Cadillac Williams. He played with Duke Ellington’s band.” So I bought this five volume set of Duke Ellington records. I’m trying to think of the name of the tune, I think it’s called “Brown Betty” if I remember right. Sounds like Clark Terry. I think it was his mentor when he was in the band.
You know he was great to me. I mean I have to tell you, you see that video? That one with where I played the solo right after he did?
Okay, well the other guy that was in there, that played the bridge, that’s Richard Williams. He was in the original Thad Jones-Mel Lewis band.
That’s right. I remember that from the liner notes.
